title: Microsoft Purview: DLP and auto-labeling policies for non-Microsoft connected apps
summary: Hold: the statement that no per-asset price is published could not be substantiated. Microsoft's pricing page contains an At Rest Protection price table, but the retrieved amounts are placeholders, which cannot establish that Microsoft has not published a rate. The rollout, policy requirements and automation checks otherwise support the briefing, with minor navigation and checklist corrections.

claims.fix: Remove 'The per-unit price is not yet published' from licensing.notes and 'The price per data asset is not yet published' from the body. Rename the body's 'Not yet published' label to 'Pricing to confirm'. Replace the price declaration with 'Confirm the applicable At Rest Protection rate on the Microsoft Purview pricing page before enabling policies.' Cite https://azure.microsoft.com/pricing/details/purview/. Keep the open question about the applicable rate without asserting that no rate is published.
